data.one_liner: Vimeo and YouTube video player for Flutter with customizable controls.
data.what_it_does: Provides a video player widget and controller that supports playing videos from YouTube and Vimeo, including private videos and live streams, with a YouTube-like overlay interface and customizable progress bars and controls.
use_when: You need to play YouTube or Vimeo videos inside your Flutter app.
You want customizable video player controls and overlays similar to YouTube.
You need cross-platform video playback supporting Android, iOS, and Web.
avoid_when: You need a simple raw video player without YouTube/Vimeo parsing dependencies.
You require advanced production-level web CORS support natively without external workarounds.
strengths: Supports playing YouTube and Vimeo videos via URL or ID
Customizable controls, progress bars, and labels
Built-in support for changing video quality and playback speed
weaknesses: Web usage requires CORS configuration or workarounds
Video playlists are still marked as a TODO
data.setup_notes: Requires INTERNET permission on Android and NSAppTransportSecurity configuration on iOS. Web setup may require CORS handling.

alternatives.name: chewie
alternatives.why_pick_it: A mature video player controller built on top of video_player with customizable controls and support for multiple data sources.
